open_points.subject: Contract activation after trial-corpus growth
open_points.text: “Each contract version has a trial corpus”; “an activation binds a contract version to one admitted implementation”; “activation ... requires an `admitted` verdict over the current corpus”; but adding or capturing a TrialCase grows the corpus without saying what happens to the existing current activation.
open_points.question: After the corpus grows, is the existing activation still usable by new runs, automatically re-admitted, or unusable until its implementation is submitted and admitted over the new corpus?
options: Keep the existing activation usable under its earlier verdict
Automatically re-run admission for the activated implementation
Treat the activation as unusable until a current-corpus admission exists
open_points.default_guess: Treat the activation as unusable for new runs until the implementation is admitted over the current corpus.

open_points.subject: Try implementation action
open_points.text: “try an implementation | agent | trial evidence per case” and M07 defines one TrialExecution for one implementation and one trial case, but neither text says which cases one try request executes.
open_points.question: Does one try action execute the implementation against every case in the current corpus, one selected existing case, or request-supplied ad hoc inputs?
options: Run every case in the current corpus
Run request-supplied inputs that need not be TrialCases
open_points.default_guess: Run every case in the current corpus and return one TrialExecution per case.

open_points.subject: TrialExecution provenance
open_points.text: M07 says “The sandbox's observation, recorded by the kernel,” while the primary action assigns “try an implementation” to an agent and admission also creates TrialExecutions; M07 carries no requester or indication of whether the execution came from a try action or an admission.
open_points.question: What fact distinguishes an agent-requested trial execution from a kernel-run admission execution, and which agent requested a manual trial?
options: Record requester and trigger kind on each TrialExecution
Introduce a trial-request or trial-batch model that owns the executions
Infer admission executions from AdmissionVerdict membership and do not retain the requester of manual trials
open_points.default_guess: Record both the requesting Actor and whether the trigger was manual try or admission.

open_points.subject: Run recovery after process restart
open_points.text: M26 says an EffectAttempt is “Read by the run's recovery after restart,” but M19 defines no restart transition or recovery action for a durable run left `running`; `resume` is limited to nodes waiting on an unreachable service.
open_points.question: After restart, what happens to a run persisted as `running`, including nodes with no concluded NodeExecution and any persisted `in_flight` EffectAttempt?
options: The kernel automatically recovers the run, safely re-executing pure/read work and converting uncertain effects to `outcome_unknown`
The run becomes `pending` and requires an explicit recovery or resume action
The run remains `running` with no recovery behavior
open_points.default_guess: Automatically recover it: retry work that cannot cause effects, convert persisted in-flight effects to unknown outcomes, and leave the run pending where owner resolution is required.
